title: 第7章 美味烤鱼，胖子抢食
slug: 斗罗冬儿重生我不是唐舞桐
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

鱼烤得两面都金灿灿的，滋滋地冒着油泡。

霍雨浩最后撒上一点辣椒，香味再次激发出来。

王冬儿香得都快流口水了。

“王冬，尝一尝，看好不好吃。”

霍雨浩拿着一条鱼递给王冬儿。

“你不是要用来卖钱的吗？给我一条可就少卖一条的钱咯。”

“没关系的，我们是好朋友嘛。再说你请我吃了那么多东西，我给你的不过是一条鱼罢了。”

“那我就不客气了。”

王冬儿接过来闻了一下，实在是太香了。

她张开嘴，轻轻咬了一口。鱼皮脆脆的，里面的鱼肉却很嫩，而且非常入味。

“好吃！”

听到王冬儿说好吃，霍雨浩也很开心。

他看着王冬儿啃鱼的样子，觉得好可爱啊。

“同学，你这烤鱼好香啊，怎么卖的？”一些学生被香气吸引围了过来。

“五个铜魂币一条。”

“嗯，不贵，给我来一条。”

霍雨浩刚刚烤出来的几条鱼，一下子就被抢空了。

他赶紧换上新鲜的鱼，开始新一轮烤制。

“给我一条，我也要一条。”

人群越来越多。

“大家别急，站成一排。”王冬儿帮忙维持秩序。

“只剩下17条烤鱼，每个人只能买一条。”

王冬儿按照顺序选出17个顾客，然后让其他顾客先离开，不要继续等了。

霍雨浩加快速度，双手飞速翻动烤鱼。

在灵眸的辅助下，他对火候的把控好到极致。

王冬儿觉得，这些实力一般的魂师，就应该将武魂运用到生活中，效率和质量会大大提高。

没过多久，霍雨浩就把十七条烤鱼全都卖光了，剩下两条是他答应给唐雅留着的。

“雨浩，你好厉害啊，感觉以后你可以开一个烤鱼店欸。”

“真的吗？我倒是没有想过。”霍雨浩被夸得有些不好意思。

就在这时，一个十四五岁的少女走过来，被烤鱼的香味吸引住了。

她长得很好看，霍雨浩忍不住多看了一眼。

“学弟，你这烤鱼怎么卖的？”

The fish was grilled until both sides were golden and sizzling with oil.

Huo Yuhao finally sprinkled a little chili pepper, and the fragrance was stimulated again.

Wang Donger smelled so good that she almost drooled.

"Wang Dong, give it a try and see if it tastes good."

Huo Yuhao handed a fish to Wang Donger.

"Aren't you going to sell them for money? Give me one and you'll save money by selling one."

"It doesn't matter, we are good friends. Besides, you treated me to so many things, and all I gave you was a fish."

"Then I won't be polite."

Wang Donger took it and smelled it. It was so fragrant.

She opened her mouth and took a small bite.The fish skin is crispy, but the fish meat inside is tender and very tasty.

“Delicious!”

Huo Yuhao was also very happy when he heard Wang Donger say it was delicious.

He looked at Wang Donger chewing the fish and thought it was so cute.

"Classmate, your grilled fish smells so good. How do you sell it?" Some students were attracted by the aroma and gathered around.

"Five copper soul coins each."

"Well, it's not expensive. Give me one."

The few fish Huo Yuhao had just grilled were all sold out in no time.

He quickly replaced it with fresh fish and started a new round of grilling.

"Give me one, I want one too."

The crowd is getting bigger.

"Don't worry, everyone, stand in a row." Wang Dong'er helped maintain order.

"There are only 17 grilled fish left, and each person can only buy one."

Wang Donger selected 17 customers in order, and then asked other customers to leave first and stop waiting.

Huo Yuhao increased his speed and quickly flipped the grilled fish with both hands.

With the help of Spirit Eyes, he could control the heat extremely well.

Wang Donger feels that these soul masters with average strength should apply martial arts in their lives, and the efficiency and quality will be greatly improved.

It didn't take long for Huo Yuhao to sell out all seventeen grilled fishes, leaving two that he promised to keep for Tang Ya.

"Yuhao, you are so awesome. I feel like you can open a grilled fish restaurant in the future."

"Really? I haven't thought about it." Huo Yuhao was a little embarrassed by the praise.

At this moment, a girl of fourteen or fifteen years old came over and was attracted by the smell of grilled fish.

She was so good-looking that Huo Yuhao couldn't help but take a second look at her.

"Junior, how do you sell grilled fish?"
